standard_prerequisites.use: Elementary etale neighbourhoods, isolated points of a fibre, and finiteness of a morphism over an etale base change; the assembly is retained.

core_obligations: For each isolated fibre point produce a finite piece over a neighbourhood, using isolation in the fibre.
Assemble the pieces over a single elementary etale neighbourhood and verify the finiteness, uniqueness and residue field conditions.

proof_roadmap.step: Use isolation of each point to build local finite pieces.
Pass to a common elementary etale neighbourhood.
Assemble and verify the listed conditions.

difficulty_reason: Given a locally finite type morphism and finitely many isolated points of a fibre mapping to one base point, the lemma produces one elementary etale neighbourhood of the base point and, for each given point, an open subscheme of the base change that is finite over the neighbourhood and has a unique point over the base point mapping to the given point with equal residue field. The proof handles each point using its isolation in the fibre, then assembles the pieces over a common etale neighbourhood so that all conditions hold simultaneously. Making one neighbourhood serve all points is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 11997-12012.
